node.content-desc: U two: up face half turn
R two: right face half turn
F two: front face half turn
x: whole cube clockwise, like R
x prime: whole cube counter-clockwise, like R
x two: whole cube half turn, like R
y: whole cube clockwise, like U
y prime: whole cube counter-clockwise, like U
y two: whole cube half turn, like U
z: whole cube clockwise, like F
z prime: whole cube counter-clockwise, like F
z two: whole cube half turn, like F
Recognition diagram for: Orient the edges: dot.

node.text: You orient the four last-layer edges so a yellow cross shows on top. This is the first look of 2-look OLL.
Keep the first two layers solved. The Algorithm moves them, then puts them back.
